# sonarqube_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group by its exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact group name.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) Whether every user is a member (the built-in `sonar-users` group).
- `description` (String) Group description.
- `id` (String) Group UUID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the group is provisioned by an external system (SCIM, GitHub, GitLab).
